    "click>=8.1.0",
    "pydantic>=2.12.5,<3.0.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.0.0,<3.0.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.2,<7.0.0",
    "packaging>=24.0",
    "aiokafka>=0.13.0",
    # OMN-14528: node_runtime_sweep.broker_probe uses the confluent AdminClient

    "confluent-kafka>=2.12.0,<3.0.0",
    "asyncpg>=0.30.0",
    "fastapi>=0.115.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.30.0",
    "python-dateutil>=2.9.0",
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.10",
    "httpx>=0.27.0",
    "anthropic>=0.25.0",
    "omninode-memory>=0.18.0,<0.19.0",
    "radon>=6.0.1",
    # OMN-16024: floor raised 8.4.0 -> 9.0.3 (CVE-2025-71176, insecure tmpdir DoS).
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.3.0",
    "docker>=7.0.0",
    "rich>=13.0.0",
    # OMN-14893: GitHub App JWT signing + installation-token exchange for the
    # OCC machine-auth path (github_app_auth.py). Already an unconditional
    # transitive dep via omnibase-infra>=... (pyjwt>=2.12.0); floor is the fixed release for the 2.13.0 advisories (GHSA-ffc3-869f-jxw9 and five HIGH); declared
    # directly so this repo does not depend on that transitivity holding.
    "pyjwt[crypto]>=2.15.1",
    # OMN-16375: security floor for pyasn1 DoS advisories reported by the
    # dependency scan against pyasn1 0.6.3 (CVE-2026-59885/CVE-2026-59886).
    "pyasn1>=0.6.4",
    # OMN-15193: JSON-Schema structural validation for a contract-declared
    # delegation response_contract (handler_quality_gate.py). Already an
    # unconditional transitive dep (dependency-injector / mcp pull in
    # jsonschema>=4.26.0); declared directly so this repo does not depend on
    # that transitivity holding -- it is a boring, already-resolved validator,
    # not a new addition to the resolved dependency set.
    "jsonschema>=4.18.0",
    "cryptography>=50.0.1,<51.0.0",
    # age (X25519) client-side encryption of topic archives before they leave
    # the host; the archiver holds only the public recipient.
    "pyrage>=1.4.0,<2.0.0",
    # S3 sink and KMS envelope encryption of topic archives; already resolved
    # through omnibase-infra, declared here because omnimarket now imports it.
    "boto3>=1.43.0,<2.0.0",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    # OMN-16024: floor raised 8.4.0 -> 9.0.3 (CVE-2025-71176, insecure tmpdir DoS).
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.3.0",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0.0",
    "pytest-split>=0.10.0",
    # OMN-17564: REQUIRED by the pre-push remote leg, not optional tooling.
    # prepush_dispatch.sh ships "-n<N> --dist=loadgroup --timeout=60
    # --timeout-method=signal" to every dispatched heavy suite. `-n`/`--dist`

    # `uv sync --all-extras` produces an environment where pytest exits on
    # "unrecognized arguments" and EVERY escalated push is a false RED.
    # Bounds match omnibase_infra so the two repos resolve the same majors.
    "pytest-xdist>=3.5.0,<4.0.0",
    "pytest-timeout>=2.3.0,<3.0.0",
    "pre-commit==4.5.1",
    "ruff>=0.14.13,<0.16.0",
    "mypy>=1.19.1",
    "types-pyyaml>=6.0.12.20250822",
    "types-jsonschema>=4.25.1.20251222",
]

    # move and not only the lock. Raised in BOTH places in lockstep: the
    # [tool.uv] override below is what decides the resolve for transitive
    # consumers, and a floor raised in only one of the two is the
    # masked-incompatibility failure this file warns about above.

    # ``ModelQualityRuleEvaluation``, ``EnumQualityRuleEnforcement`` and the
    # ``rule_evaluations`` field on ``ModelDelegationResult``. This repo now
    # imports both types unconditionally (the local duplicate was deleted so
    # one wire field has one definition) and the orchestrator stamps the field
    # on every quality-gate terminal, so an older core fails at IMPORT rather
    # than degrading -- and even if it did not, ``ModelDelegationResult`` is
    # ``extra="forbid"``, so the stamp would raise at terminal construction and
    # strand the workflow. Raised in BOTH places in lockstep: the [tool.uv]
    # override below is what actually decides the resolve for transitive
    # consumers, and a floor raised in only one of the two is the
    # masked-incompatibility failure this file warns about above.
    # OMN-17802: 0.47.13 -> 0.47.14. 0.47.14 is the first release carrying the
    # canonical delegation terminal topic registry rows (OMN-15622, core #1691)
    # alongside the three concrete v2 terminal wire classes (OMN-17841, core
    # #1653). The orchestrator resolves both from the published wheel, so a
    # resolve below this floor cannot import the classes it now constructs.

    # core#1737 (the TERMINAL_CONSTRUCTION_FAILED outcome and UNDETERMINED
    # verdict). Migration 0045 filters on exactly that pair and omnibase_infra
    # vendors it from here. Raised in BOTH places in lockstep.
    # OMN-19961: floor raised 0.47.23 -> 0.47.24, the first release that
    # registers the per-host dev lane the configured runtime profile (core#1771).
    # node_projection_lab_container_memory scopes itself to that lane, and an
    # older core refuses the contract at discovery. Raised in BOTH places.
    # OMN-20025: floor raised 0.47.24 -> 0.47.25, the first release with the
    # goal DoD item receipt primitives and shared evaluation reducer.
    # OMN-20117: floor raised 0.47.25 -> 0.47.27, the first release that carries
    # the RUNTIME_SHUTDOWN terminal failure cause (core#1817) the redeploy fix reads.
    # OMN-19750: onex local init also needs core>=0.47.24 (core#1786, the
    # runtime lane declaration types) and omnibase_infra>=0.38.60 (infra#4180,
    # the shipped runtime.lane example); both floors above already satisfy it.
    # OMN-20368: floor raised 0.47.28 -> 0.47.31, the first release carrying the
    # Done-write receipt gate (core#1852): handler_done_write_receipt_gate and
    # models.ticket.model_done_write_decision. node_linear_triage imports both
    # unconditionally, so an older core fails at import. Raised in BOTH places.
    # OMN-20679: floor raised 0.47.31 -> 0.47.34, the first release whose shared
    # publish_and_poll takes client_security (the bus CLI and coding-agent adapter of
    # node_architecture_discovery_orchestrator call it). Raised in BOTH places.

    # whose EnumContextFactor carries the session and tier factors (core#1987,
    # TA.2). ModelContextProfile validates them, compaction_orchestrator selects
    # them, and node_context_pack_render_compute classifies chunks by them.
    # Raised in BOTH places.
    # OMN-17427: floor raised 0.47.44 -> 0.47.46, the first release carrying the

    # OMN-17427: floor raised 0.47.46 -> 0.47.47, the first release whose
    # delegation wire request admits the brief_drafting task class (core#2029).
    # Raised in BOTH places.
    # OMN-17427: core 0.47.48 admits extraction_proposer, tail_summary and context_selection

    # OMN-21264: floor raised 0.47.48 -> 0.47.53, the first release whose terminal

    # OMN-23518: floor raised 0.23.3 -> 0.23.15, the release whose notes list the lane process
    # wire models (omnibase_spi CHANGELOG v0.23.15, "Included Since v0.23.14": ProtocolLaneProcessRunner

    # OMN-17980: floor raised 0.38.18 -> 0.38.19. 0.38.19 is the release cut to

    # 0.38.18 pins the regressed 0.47.3, so the two floors move together or the

    # OMN-18159: floor raised 0.38.19 -> 0.38.22. The delegation node's four

    # the omnibase-infra release, not of this repo: 0.38.22 is the first cut

    # than degrading.
    # OMN-16976: floor raised 0.38.22 -> 0.38.29. 0.38.29 is the release cut
    # from omnibase_infra dev at e1ecbac6f (tag v0.38.29), the first published
    # release carrying the 116 commits merged since v0.38.27. It declares
    # `omnibase-core==0.47.16`, which the core floor above admits.
    # OMN-18565: floor raised 0.38.29 -> 0.38.30. 0.38.30 is the release cut from
    # omnibase_infra dev at 306a12be7 (tag v0.38.30), the first published release
    # carrying omnibase_infra#3679 (068c3a0c1): the kernel projection seam injects
    # the envelope tenant under `_tenant_id`. Below this floor the deployed pod
    # injects no tenant, `envelope_tenant_identity` resolves None for every event,

    # with the terminal write for the same correlation under FORCE ROW LEVEL
    # SECURITY. It declares `omnibase-core==0.47.16`, which the core floor admits.
    # OMN-18638: floor raised 0.38.30 -> 0.38.31. The binding table this repo's
    # base contract is checked against ships INSIDE the installed distribution
    # (`omnibase_infra.runtime.models.model_bifrost_lane_backend_binding._AUTHORIZED_BINDINGS`),
    # so which release is installed decides what
    # tests/unit/delegation/test_base_contract_agrees_with_installed_lab_bindings_omn18626.py
    # compares against. omnimarket#2627 moved this repo's `model_name` to the
    # served `Qwen3.8-27B`; the matching omnibase_infra half is 0ee5bb023
    # (omnibase_infra#3721), and 0.38.31 is the first published release carrying
    # it. At 0.38.30 the two halves disagree, the OMN-18626 guard is red, and
    # `render_bifrost_delegation_contract._merge_lane_overlay` would refuse the
    # rendered contract outright -- the next container start on a lab lane FAILS
    # TO START rather than routing badly. It declares `omnibase-core==0.47.16`
    # and `omnibase-spi==0.23.3`, both of which the floors above admit, so this
    # bump cascades nothing.
    # OMN-19969: floor raised to 0.38.61, the first omnibase_infra release
    # that prices claude-sonnet-5-5 (omnibase_infra#4400). omnimarket#3172
    # changed DEFAULT_BASELINE_MODEL to claude-sonnet-5-5; below 0.38.61 the
    # premium counterfactual is None, so every savings row is BASELINE_UNRESOLVED.
    # 0.38.61 declares omnibase-compat==0.5.7 and omnibase-spi==0.23.5; the
    # core floor above admits it, so this bump cascades nothing.
    # OMN-20833: floor raised to 0.38.70, the first omnibase_infra release whose
    # pricing manifest carries the providers' published rates (omnibase_infra#4631):
    # claude-opus-4-6 at $5 / $25 per MTok, not $15 / $75. 0.38.70 declares
    # omnibase-compat==0.5.7, omnibase-core>=0.47.31 and omnibase-spi==0.23.5; the
    # floors above admit them, so this bump cascades nothing.
    # OMN-17427: floor raised to 0.38.71, the first omnibase_infra release that
    # vendors the lab_job, run_trace and tenant_credentials 0006/0007 node
    # migrations, so the Sibling Release Compatibility Gate finds them in the
    # pinned release. 0.38.71 declares the same omnibase-compat, omnibase-core
    # and omnibase-spi bounds as 0.38.70, so this bump cascades nothing.
    # OMN-18946: floor raised to 0.38.72, the first omnibase_infra release that
    # vendors the claude_hook_events 0007 node migration (omnibase_infra#4933), so the
    # Sibling Release Compatibility Gate finds it in the pinned release. 0.38.72
    # declares the same omnibase-compat, omnibase-core and omnibase-spi bounds as
    # 0.38.71, so this bump cascades nothing.
    # OMN-19438: floor raised to 0.38.74, the first omnibase_infra release that
    # vendors the savings_estimates 095 house-tenant rebackfill node migration
    # byte-identical, so the Sibling Release Compatibility Gate finds it in the

    "omnibase-infra>=0.38.75,<0.39.0",
    "click>=8.1.0",
    "pydantic>=2.12.5,<3.0.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.0.0,<3.0.0",

    "confluent-kafka>=2.12.0,<3.0.0",

    "python-dateutil>=2.9.0",

    "httpx>=0.27.0",

    "omninode-memory>=0.18.0,<0.19.0",
    "radon>=6.0.1",
    # OMN-16024: floor raised 8.4.0 -> 9.0.3 (CVE-2025-71176, insecure tmpdir DoS).
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.3.0",

    # OMN-14893: GitHub App JWT signing + installation-token exchange for the

    # transitive dep via omnibase-infra>=... (pyjwt>=2.12.0); floor is the fixed release for the 2.13.0 advisories (GHSA-ffc3-869f-jxw9 and five HIGH); declared

    "pyjwt[crypto]>=2.15.1",
